name: Etoposide
mechanism: Stabilises the topoisomerase II-DNA cleavage complex, preventing religation of double-strand breaks and causing cell death, predominantly in S and G2 phases.
keyToxicities: Hypersensitivity and hypotension with rapid infusion
Therapy-related acute myeloid leukaemia (often with MLL/KMT2A rearrangement)
interactions: An oral formulation exists with variable bioavailability. Dose adjustment is required in renal impairment.
resistance: Reduced topoisomerase II expression or mutation and drug efflux (P-glycoprotein/MRP).
